title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: First-page Technologies inventory, validated from Randstad's full job descriptions. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 21, 2026 — full first-page refresh (30 postings, dated Sept 17-21); no eligible target-family postings this run.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Reviewed all 30 postings exposed on the first Technologies category page, dated September 17-21, 2026; no pagination requested.

No SRE/Platform/DevOps-center-of-gravity posting on the current first page was both on-topic and within the reachable geography/remote rules this run — every plausible match this cycle was Toronto or Oakville hybrid.

The previously Applied DevOps Specialist — REMOTE posting (applications.md, Applied 2026-09-16) was confirmed Expired on Randstad's site as of the 2026-09-19 run and is not part of today's first-page inventory (older job ID, already rotated out); no status change made in applications.md.
All retrieval was read-only via direct HTTP fetch with a standard browser user-agent; no application, email, profile, account, or form action was used.

rows.title: Production Support Specialist (Client Connectivity & Payments)
rows.gap: Real SRE/production-support center of gravity — incident management, RCA, monitoring/observability (Splunk, AppDynamics, Geneos), ITIL — but Toronto hybrid is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal); not take-able.

rows.title: Systems Integrator
rows.location: Toronto, ON — Hybrid (up to 2 days remote)
rows.gap: Real Platform/Infrastructure fit — Azure landing zones, VMware-to-Azure lift-and-shift, Terraform IaC, hybrid networking — but downtown-Toronto hybrid (3+ office days/week) is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal); not take-able.

rows.title: Lead Full Stack Developer — React, Cloud, CI/CD, Hybrid
rows.gap: Despite "Cloud, CI/CD" in the title, the actual requirements are application-development-centric (React/Next.js/TypeScript 7Y+, GraphQL, API design) with cloud/DevOps as supporting context, not the job itself — wrong domain center of gravity. Also Oakville hybrid (3 days/week on-site), outside the reachable-city range.

rows.title: Mainframe Production Support Specialist
rows.gap: Production-support framing but the actual required depth is mainframe-specific (CICS, DB2, COBOL, MQ, TWS, SPUFI) — a skill set Marc does not have, so wrong domain center of gravity. Also Toronto hybrid, outside the reachable-city range.

rows.title: Security Specialist V (Senior IT Risk & Regulatory Remediation Specialist)
rows.location: Toronto, ON — Hybrid (2 days/week on-site, expanding to 4)
rows.gap: GRC/audit and regulatory-remediation governance role, not DevSecOps engineering — wrong domain center of gravity. Also Toronto hybrid (expanding to 4 days/week on-site), outside the reachable-city range.
